title: Herbed Quinoa and Chickpea Pilaf
description: This protein-rich side dish is loaded with flavor and quick to prepare! Nutritious GOYA® Organic Quinoa is simmered beautifully with recaíto and orange juice. Then, plump and nutty GOYA® Chick Peas are stirred in, along with fresh mint, parsley and hazelnuts.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon GOYA® Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 (15.5 ounce) can GOYA® Chick Peas, rinsed and drained
0.33333334326744 cup toasted hazelnuts or pistachios, chopped

steps.text: Combine oil, Recaito, quinoa, orange juice, salt and 3/4 cup water to boil. Simmer covered over medium-low heat, until liquid is absorbed and quinoa is tender, 20 minutes. Stir in chick peas. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Stir in mint, parsley and hazelnuts.
